description.value: These sleek red boots feel pleasantly warm to the touch. While wearing emberwalker boots, you gain resistance 1 to fire damage and ignore fire effects on surfaces. --- Activate—Ember Step [two-actions] (manipulate) Frequency once per day Effect You Stride. Each square you move through during your Stride is scorched with bright flames, becoming hazardous terrain for 1 minute. A non-flying creature that moves through one of these spaces takes 1 fire damage.
